rules.starting_kit: Printed Background kit plus the kit of the character's highest Path (ties: the Method's first Path), option A or B.
rules.choices: Every choice is a closed menu; the local model picks, and the first option is the deterministic fallback.
rules.trinkets: Printed entries with no catalog item are kept verbatim with value 0; nothing is invented.
rules.unprinted_quantity: Where the printed kit names an item without a quantity, one is given (quantity_printed false).
rules.currency: Coin in Copper Cash (1 ST = 10 CC, 1 GT = 100 CC); low-gold economy.

wealth.rule: Treasure budget = CL budget x Background wealth tier x seeded 1d20 fortune multiplier; the Realm grade cap still applies.

tianxia.background.abandoned_orphan.raw_authority: You begin with worn common clothes, a small knife, thieves' tools, a bedroll, a hidden pouch, three days of poor rations, and one keepsake from the life you lost or never had.

entries.printed: one keepsake from the life you lost or never had

tianxia.background.ancestral_shrine_keep.raw_authority: You begin with plain ritual clothes, incense, calligrapher’s supplies, a family or shrine token, a small bell, a pouch of offerings, and a copied list of names.

tianxia.background.artisan_s_child.raw_authority: You begin with work clothes, one artisan’s tool, a measuring cord, chalk or charcoal, repair scraps, a half-finished object, and a promise owed to or by your teacher.

entries.printed: a promise owed to or by your teacher

tianxia.background.beast_hunter.raw_authority: You begin with travel clothes, a hunting knife, a simple ranged weapon or spear, trapper’s tools or leatherworker’s tools, a coil of cord, trail rations, and a trophy from a beast you survived.

entries.printed: a simple ranged weapon or spear
a trophy from a beast you survived

tianxia.background.border_scout.raw_authority: You begin with travel clothes, a shortbow or simple ranged weapon, a map case, chalk or trail markers, a weather cloak, five days of rations, and a warning token from a border post.

entries.printed: a shortbow or simple ranged weapon
a warning token from a border post

tianxia.background.clan_heir.raw_authority: You begin with quality clothes, a clan token, writing tools, a family letter, a signet or seal, and a small inherited keepsake.

tianxia.background.criminal_runner.raw_authority: You begin with practical dark clothes, thieves’ tools, a small knife, a coded token, a concealed pouch, cheap travel papers, and one sealed message you were never supposed to read.

entries.printed: one sealed message you were never supposed to read

tianxia.background.cursed_bloodline.raw_authority: You begin with travel clothes, a hooded cloak, a family token, a charm meant to hide or suppress your mark, ink and paper, and a small weapon.

entries.printed: a charm meant to hide or suppress your mark

tianxia.background.dream_touched.raw_authority: You begin with soft travel clothes, a dream journal, ink, a sleeping mat, incense, a small charm against nightmares, and one strange object you do not remember obtaining.

entries.printed: one strange object you do not remember obtaining

tianxia.background.exiled_noble.raw_authority: You begin with worn fine clothes, a concealed family token, a small weapon, a letter you have not decided whether to destroy, and enough coin to look respectable once.

entries.printed: a letter you have not decided whether to destroy
enough coin to look respectable once
entries.note: The printed kit names coin without an amount; owner ruling 2026-09-22 sets 1d20 Gold Taels.
